panels.title: Page views
panels.description: Client page_view events reported by Faro (one per route change and initial load).

panels.title: Unique pages
panels.description: Number of distinct route patterns seen in the range.

targets.expr: count(count by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_view" | route=~"$route" [$__range])))

panels.title: Product views
panels.description: Product detail pages opened (course/diploma/package/consultation).

panels.title: Product clicks
panels.description: Product-card clicks across every surface.

panels.title: Page views over time, by route

targets.expr: sum by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_view" | route=~"$route" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Top pages by views
panels.description: Pages ranked by page_view count; the “Page” column is the route pattern.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_view" | route=~"$route" [$__range])))

panels.title: Page share (map)
panels.description: Each tile is a page, sized by its share of views.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="page_view" | route=~"$route" [$__range]))

panels.title: Clicks on $route
panels.description: Product card clicks recorded while on this route.

panels.title: Products clicked from $route
panels.description: Which courses/diplomas/packages/consultations were clicked from this page.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (product_kind, legacy_entity_id, title) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_click" | route=~"$route" [$__range])))

panels.title: Most clicked products

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (product_kind, legacy_entity_id, title) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_click" [$__range])))

panels.description: Products ranked by product_click count, with their type and title.

panels.title: Most viewed products

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (product_kind, legacy_entity_id, title) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_view" [$__range])))

panels.description: Products ranked by product_view count (detail pages opened).

panels.title: Conversion funnel
panels.description: Event counts per funnel step; the drop between bars is the conversion loss.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="measurement"} |= " ttfb=" | logfmt | unwrap ttfb [$__range])
avg_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="measurement"} |= " fcp=" | logfmt | unwrap fcp [$__range])
avg_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="measurement"} |= " lcp=" | logfmt | unwrap lcp [$__range])
avg_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="measurement"} |= " cls=" | logfmt | unwrap cls [$__range])
quantile_over_time(0.75, {app_id=~"$app_id", kind="measurement"} |= " ttfb=" | logfmt | unwrap ttfb [5m])

panels.title: Total requests
panels.description: Inbound server spans (any status) tagged with http.route.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "$service" && span.http.route != nil } && status = error | count_over_time() by (span.http.route)

panels.title: Searches over time
panels.description: Every search/filter/sort/pagination on the search page.

panels.title: Top search terms
panels.description: Most frequent search queries (no free-text entries are blank).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (query) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="search" | query!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Pages by clicks
panels.description: Which pages receive the most product-card clicks.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_click" [$__range])))

panels.title: Clicks by surface
panels.description: Where the card was clicked: search, landing rails, recommendations, wishlist, expert grids…

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (surface) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_click" [$__range])))

panels.title: Engagement by product type
panels.description: Per product type: detail-page views, card clicks, wishlist adds and cart adds.

panels.title: Clicks by card position
panels.description: Click share by the card's position in its rail/result list (0 = first).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (position) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_click" | position!="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Detail page views by type
panels.description: Views of each detail route (course, diploma, package, consultation, expert, live).

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (route) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="product_view" [$__range])))

panels.title: Search detail (by product type filter)
panels.description: Search actions grouped by the product types the visitor filtered on.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (types) (count_over_time({app_id=~"$app_id", kind="event"} | logfmt | event_name="search" | types!="" [$__range])))
